cloud_addresses_prefix_shape.name: cloud_addresses_prefix_shape
cloud_addresses_prefix_shape.value: ("cloud_addresses"."kind" = 'host' and "cloud_addresses"."prefix_length" is null) or ("cloud_addresses"."kind" = 'prefix' and "cloud_addresses"."prefix_length" is not null)

cloud_addresses_prefix_length_valid.name: cloud_addresses_prefix_length_valid
cloud_addresses_prefix_length_valid.value: "cloud_addresses"."prefix_length" is null or ("cloud_addresses"."family" = '4' and "cloud_addresses"."prefix_length" between 0 and 32) or ("cloud_addresses"."family" = '6' and "cloud_addresses"."prefix_length" between 0 and 128)

probe_rounds_target.name: probe_rounds_target
probe_rounds_target.value: ("probe_rounds"."slot_id" is not null and "probe_rounds"."endpoint_id" is null and "probe_rounds"."endpoint_address_id" is null) or ("probe_rounds"."slot_id" is null and "probe_rounds"."endpoint_id" is not null and "probe_rounds"."endpoint_address_id" is not null)

probe_tokens_kind.name: probe_tokens_kind
probe_tokens_kind.value: "probe_tokens"."kind" in ('install', 'runtime') and ("probe_tokens"."kind" <> 'install' or "probe_tokens"."expires_at" is not null)

rotation_policy_bounds.name: rotation_policy_bounds
rotation_policy_bounds.value: "rotation_policies"."revision" > 0 and "rotation_policies"."max_attempts" between 1 and 20 and "rotation_policies"."min_interval_seconds" between 60 and 86400 and "rotation_policies"."cloud_wait_seconds" between 10 and 3600 and "rotation_policies"."candidate_window_seconds" between 15 and 86400
